items.title: Etale local structure of a family of curves at a singular point of the fibre: etale pullback to the standard uv - a family over Z[a]
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file curves.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma produces the standard etale-local model of a nodal family (statement lines 5293-5312 with the two-square diagram). The proof (lines 5314-5388) is a three-stage argument: absolute Noetherian approximation to reduce to finite type over Z, an etale base change that realizes the degree 2 separable residue algebra of the node so that it becomes split, and finally Artin approximation applied to the completed isomorphism with the explicit model algebra Z[u, v, a]/(uv - a). H3: each stage is a genuine technique and the composition with the base-change compatibility of the singular locus is not routine.
